featured_reviews.name: Shuvankar Patra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience ordering from your website. This was my first time purchasing from you, and unfortunately, it has been very frustrating.

After placing the order, I called your team to request expedited delivery and agreed to pay on delivery on Thursday. I was informed that it would ship out on Friday to Kolkata. However, there were no updates until Tuesday. When I followed up, I was shocked to learn that Satguru had canceled my order without proper communication.

I placed this order because I have an international flight next week and needed to carry the item with me abroad. The delay and cancellation have put me in a very difficult situation.

Additionally, I was asked via WhatsApp to pay INR 2500 for delivery charges, even though your website clearly states free delivery. This inconsistency is unacceptable and feels misleading.

In contrast, I placed an order with The Bombay Store, and they delivered the very next day without charging any extra delivery fees. I have been their customer since 2015 and have always had a reliable experience. This situation clearly shows the difference in professionalism and customer service.

If I had been informed earlier about the issue, I would have ordered from another website and avoided this inconvenience. Because of this delay and cancellation, I am now unable to bring the Hindu deity with me as planned.

I sincerely hope you review your customer service, communication practices, and delivery policies so other customers do not face similar disappointment.

In conversation I told the lady I am going to share this matter in social media she said go head we do not care , it's ok.

Brand matters.

featured_reviews.name: Romit Mitra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've come here about seven or eight times over the last ten years for their framing services.

They are superb. Not only is their execution of the frames top notch, but what was really unexpected is the high quality of their advice while choosing framing and mounting options.

Major credit for all the art that hangs on our walls indeed go to their creators; however it's plainly acknowledged in our household that Satguru's plays a critical role for making them shine.

featured_reviews.name: Parag Sayta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had got an antique map framed at Satguru’s Andheri last year. I paid a 3x premium over local framers on the basis that I will get premium quality and service. To my shock, fungus has seeped in through the frame and spoilt the map within a year. There is no particular dampness or moisture on the wall where the map was kept.

When I went to Satguru’s Andheri, they said they can’t do anything about it and I need to visit Satguru’s Khar. At Satguru’s Khar, they said there will be an INR 5,000/- extra charge to replace the wood at the back of the frame(!). I wasn’t expecting free service, but looking to charge so much a year after I purchased the frame and making me run around from Andheri to Khar has made this a bitter experience. On top of this, there was zero sympathy or service etiquette from the owner or staff- all they were looking to do was to argue that it wasn’t their fault and they bore no responsibility for this.

I will never buy anything from Satguru’s again and would encourage others to also look at alternative options which offer better service and value than Satguru’s.

featured_reviews.review_text: They have a good collection and I have even purchased a few artefacts, showpieces and decorative gifts from here before. Having been a customer since the year the store first opened, I had a disrespectful experience on my last visit with my family when I was looking at the paintings and one staff member started profiling me with intrusive questions and decided to kick me and my family out. His goal was really to see how he could instil confidence in me as a patron without making any false commitments or guarantees. Highly professional and personable. Thank you Rajiv for seeing this through till the end. The artwork arrived in Toronto within a week and the professional installer said he has never in his 30 year career seen better packaging of a piece of art! From start to finish Rajiv was a class act! I’m excited to see what my next piece of art will be from Painted Rythm Art Gallery.

Highly recommended to anyone looking for premium artwork, decor, or customized installations. A perfect blend of creativity and professionalism!

Each piece felt thoughtfully selected, making it easy to connect emotionally with the art.

We ended up purchasing two stunning paintings for our home, and they have completely transformed our space. The colors, textures, and storytelling in the artwork are truly captivating—every time we walk past them, we notice something new.

The  owner’s Father and Son  duo and their staff was warm, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about the artists they represent. They took the time to understand our taste, guided us without any pressure, and helped us choose pieces that reflect our home’s personality perfectly.

We left inspired, grateful, and excited to return for more. It was an amazing experience being among the art pieces this  30 odd year old art gallery represented.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for meaningful, high-quality art and a memorable gallery experience.

I would like to share a very bad experience with the Fabindia recently !!
On 10th Dec I bought bath towels and hand towels from Fabindia Khar West branch worth INR 6,000 plus.
When I washed the towels on 13th Dec in the washing machine on delicate mode, some of the towels gave a lot of lint which got stuck onto all the towels.
On advice of the manager at the branch and after showing her the state of the towels, we wrote an email to Fabindia to make an official complaint.
After constant follow up and after another 5 emails, they agreed to exchange only 2 towels - one big and one hand towel worth only INR 1,500 - in exchange for a credit note to be used within 90 days only.
This was when I had the payment receipt and the tags on the towels all with me as a proof.
I feel Fabindia needs to give their customers better after sales service !!

featured_reviews.review_text:

Store staff does not have any training in packing these fragile goods, if you are purchasing from FabIndia you need to make sure and personally supervise the packaging because they are surely not qualified for this.
